name: MLflow
summary: Open-source AI engineering platform for agents, LLMs and ML models: OpenTelemetry-based tracing, evaluation with 50+ metrics and LLM judges, prompt registry and an AI Gateway.
description: Tracing works with any LLM provider and agent framework and supports Python, TypeScript/JavaScript and Java. Evaluation and production monitoring track quality metrics over time; the prompt registry versions prompts with lineage and supports automatic prompt optimization; the AI Gateway is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with credential management, rate limits, fallbacks and traffic splitting. A setup wizard can launch Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode to add tracing to an app. Run your own MLflow server or connect to a Databricks workspace.
